title: Fairness Perceptions of Algorithmic Decision-Making: A Systematic Review of the Empirical Literature
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on human perceptions of fairness in algorithmic decision-making, drawing examples from domains like criminal justice and hiring, and discussing sensitive attributes such as race, gender, and political affiliation, but not religion.
